_about: Synthetic reviews of the Boho listing, authored by an LLM (Claude Fable 5.1) during project setup. Ordered by submission time: review N only 'knows' reviews 1..N-1. Each review carries hand-authored atomic claims so the known-claim pool is independent of the live extractor. Theme tags are for dataset documentation only and are not used by the scorer. Some claims (free client logins, automatic weekly timesheets, no credit card for the trial, approving deliverables, milestones) are also stated in the listing; those reviews are expected to score low on replay because the listing itself is part of the known pool.

reviews.headline: Finally a PM tool my whole agency actually uses
reviews.body: We switched from spreadsheets and everyone picked it up in a day. The interface is clean and doesn't bury features in menus. Our clients love logging into the portal to see where their projects stand.
claims: The interface is clean and easy to learn
Clients like using the client portal to check project status

reviews.headline: Great value for a five-person studio
reviews.body: At $12 a seat it's much cheaper than what we were paying before. Time tracking is built right into the task, so people actually log their hours now instead of guessing at the end of the week.
claims: Pricing is affordable for small teams
Built-in time tracking makes people log hours consistently

reviews.headline: Solid, but the mobile app needs work
reviews.body: On desktop it's excellent and simple to navigate. The mobile app, though, is slow and crashes when I try to open a board with more than a few dozen cards.
claims: The desktop interface is simple to navigate

reviews.headline: The Slack integration is the killer feature
reviews.body: Every comment and status change lands in the right Slack channel. We barely open the app itself anymore because we can reply to task threads from Slack.
claims: Slack integration posts task updates to channels
You can reply to task threads from Slack
